name: Hishou Reika
source:
Daughter of a wealthy man. The younger of the twin sisters.

She has studied governance since she was a child. However, her character is as pure and innocent as she is transparent.

She is the type of person who lives with all the sins of the world on her shoulders.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=6489]getchu[/url]]
